prediction.H1_held_near_1: Filed first, the user's words (2026-11-20 task file item 3: 'file "held model reads near 1" first'): on every one of the 81 KL-matched gain-only states, the held model's reading 1 (one gain per neuron and head, commute.held_model) reads S >= held_bar (0.99). Holds when every item has a non-null S at or over the bar. Expected: 1 minus under 1e-3 on every item, because reading 1's family contains every gain-only state exactly, and the only departure is the bf16 export of the change (stage 0 measures it on the control)
prediction.R1_vpd: Over the paired items at VPD (a gain-only state with the full fine-tune of the same reference and seed that E226 read: 49 if every item reads), d = R_read(gain-only) - R_read(full fine-tune), polished set, read grade. up = the number of items with d > 0. Call 'rival a' when up >= share_a x n (40 of 49), 'rival b' when up <= share_b x n (24 of 49), else 'no call'. Card rival a (R reads a pure strengthening as kept) predicts 'rival a'; rival b (R cannot tell it from a full fine-tune) predicts 'rival b'
prediction.R2_coarse: The same rule and calls at each of E221's levels head_mlp, mlp_attn, block, over the gain-only states with an E221 full fine-tune of the same reference and seed (the nine pairs' 49, plus case_label and fresh at seeds 0 and 1: 57 if every item reads). R at head_mlp is the mean over E221's three orders, as E221's score.py reads an item. Reported beside R1, one call per level; the card's stop reads R1 and R2 together
prediction.reported_no_rule: per item: R_read and R_all, f, |K*| (polished and prefix), site-remainder share at VPD; R, f, |K*| per coarse level; held S for readings 1, 2, 3 with KL(F || M) and logit errors; KL(F || M) on D at VPD; the update size ||dW|| / ||W0||. Beside each: the full fine-tune's R (E226 at VPD, E221 per level) and its held reading 1 and 3 (E205) for the same reference and seed where saved. Per task: the gain-only seeds' sd of R at VPD (the card's spread was a proxy). The twin pairs e58_elicit_shuffle and e58_class_twin have no saved full fine-tune reading at any level: read and reported only

rules_edge_cases: n is the number of paired items with both readings present and read (an item 'no behaviour' or stopped is left out and listed). n < n_min (E221's 5): 'too few', no call. d exactly 0 is not above (ties count against rival a). All d equal 0 gives up = 0: 'rival b' (R cannot tell them apart, which is what rival b says). Do-nothing as the candidate: R = 1 at every level, so d > 0 on every item with a full R under 1 and the call is 'rival a': a rival-a call alone therefore does not show R reads a strengthening rather than nothing, and is read beside KL(F || M) on D and f, which are 0 for do-nothing and well above 0 for a KL-matched state. H1 on do-nothing: S is null (KL(F || M) <= kl_floor), so do-nothing cannot pass H1. Checked by hand against these cases before filing (2026-11-20, the writer's scratch, score.py's call())
